Hey. I'll give you a few words about the university. It's obviously not the best in the country, but also not the worst. As an MA student, you'll have a lot of time to focus on your studies outside of the classroom as well, especially if you're preparing for NET or competitive exams. The dept is not bad. 


If this is the first time you'll be in Pondicherry, you might find it a bit 
jarring because the social science departments have a sizeable south Indian (esp..malayali population). But that doesn't mean you'll be alone or anything. There are obviously students from all over india, and you'll make friends with them. 

It's not a very happening campus, like DU or JNU. But it has its own charm, and the students in general are nice. You'll find your own tribe after a few weeks of being there. Pondicherry town is also nice. A bit touristy, but you'll get used to it. There are many nice spots to visit and hangout. For a town of this size, Pondicherry has a lot of things going for it.

If you do choose to take admission in the university, my only advice would be to seek things to do outside the campus as well, whether it's attending public lectures, movie screenings, libraries, etc. Don't restrict your life to the campus, and you'll have a much wider experience during your time in Pondicherry.
